description:
This video was made possible thanks to everyone on the Simple History Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/simplehistory

The Confederacy was under blockade, low on money, and short on industry—so they leaned on a devious idea: recast a hollow artillery shell to look like a lump of coal, fill it with gunpowder, and seal it with wax and tar. The plan was simple—slip it into a Union ship’s coal pile, then eventually a worker shovels it into a boiler and it explodes. The transcript also points to two suspicious incidents in 1864 involving steamship boiler explosions, though it notes we may never know for sure. What other Civil War sabotage tricks should we cover next?
